description: Create a free 3D print quote for the selected material and actual arranged quantity. For a ChatGPT attachment, prefer the native file parameter; use fileBase64 only when the client can read the exact bytes and cannot supply a native file. Set production speed or fulfillment later with printing.quotes.update. Never invent file bytes or URLs. Reuse a stable idempotency key for retries. Returned time and grams already include all copies; use server totals and obtain customer approval before checkout.

accessToken.description: Guest token returned by printing.sessions.start. Optional when Authorization already carries a permanent key or guest token.

file.description: User-selected model file supplied by ChatGPT. Use fileName if the file metadata omits its original filename.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS download URL supplied by ChatGPT.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded model bytes without a data URL prefix.

fileName.description: Model filename ending in STL, OBJ, STEP, STP, or 3MF.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable unique key for this quote attempt.

materialId.description: AIURION material identifier listed by printing.capabilities.get. Send this when creating a quote; omission defaults to black_pla. A material change re-slices the model and invalidates the prior price approval.

quantity.description: Number of identical parts to quote, from 1 to 150.

name: printing.quotes.create

quoteId.description: AIURION quote UUID returned by printing.quotes.create.

title: Create 3D Print Quote
